components.name: Primary action
components.description: Filled teal action with a 36px fine-pointer height and a 44px coarse-pointer minimum.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: var(--control-height, 36px); align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--control-radius, 8px); background: var(--teal-action, #087f78); padding: 6px 12px; color: #fff; font: 600 13px/1.4 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, filter 180ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--teal-action-hover, #05615d); } .ds-button-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.94); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #56b9b0); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: White bordered action that shares the compact primary control size and clear focus state.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: var(--control-height, 36px); align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dbe6e6); border-radius: var(--control-radius, 8px); background: var(--white, #fff); padding: 6px 12px; color: var(--teal-dark, #05615d); font: 600 13px/1.4 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 180ms ease-out, background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--teal, #087f78); background: var(--teal-soft, #e1f3f0); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #56b9b0); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text field
components.description: Compact white field with an 8px radius; coarse-pointer screens retain 44px height and 16px input text.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label">Species name<input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Search or enter a name"></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; color: var(--ink, #102b35); font: 600 12px/1.5 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: var(--control-height, 36px); margin-top: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dbe6e6); border-radius: var(--control-radius, 8px); background: var(--white, #fff); padding: 7px 12px; color: var(--ink, #102b35); font: 400 14px/1.4 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #667c84); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--teal, #087f78); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #56b9b0); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-input { min-height: 44px; font-size: 16px; } }

components.name: Surface card
components.description: Flat white content surface with a fine border, 12px corners and 16px padding.
components.html:
Selected water

Manila Bay

Place information sits in a calm, readable panel.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid var(--line, #dbe6e6); border-radius: var(--card-radius, 12px); background: var(--white, #fff); padding: var(--card-padding, 16px); color: var(--ink, #102b35); font: 400 14px/1.5 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--ink, #102b35); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted, #667c84); }

components.name: Application navigation
components.description: Floating navigation expands to 212px or collapses to a 68px icon rail; mobile opens the same routes in a native drawer.
components.html: ExploreSpeciesMy CatchesMy SpeciesSettings
components.css: .ds-sidebar-nav { display: grid; width: 212px; gap: 4px; padding: 12px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dbe6e6); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--white, #fff); font: 400 13px/1.4 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-sidebar-link { display: flex; min-height: 40px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--muted, #667c84); text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms ease-out, background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-sidebar-link svg { flex-shrink: 0; width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-sidebar-link span { white-space: nowrap; } .ds-sidebar-link:hover { color: var(--teal-dark, #05615d); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--teal-soft, #e1f3f0) 50%, var(--white, #fff)); } .ds-sidebar-link-active { color: var(--teal-dark, #05615d); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--teal-soft, #e1f3f0) 72%, var(--white, #fff)); font-weight: 600; } .ds-sidebar-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #56b9b0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Review status chip
components.description: Compact amber capsule for review or warning status, paired with a direct text label.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 28px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--review-surface, #fffbeb); padding: 4px 10px; color: var(--review-copy, #78350f); font: 700 11px/1.4 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Selected map marker
components.description: 44px numbered map control with a white rim, a 17px label and compact lift.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-map-marker" aria-label="Select area: Manila Bay" aria-pressed="true">1</button>
components.css: .ds-map-marker { display: grid; width: 44px; height: 44px; place-items: center; border: 3px solid #fff; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--map-marker-slate, #505d6e); color: #fff; font: 700 17px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 5px 12px rgb(16 43 53 / 23%); cursor: pointer; } .ds-map-marker:hover { background: var(--map-marker-slate-hover, #354a5b); } .ds-map-marker[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--teal-action, #087f78); } .ds-map-marker:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #102b35); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Explore map panel frame
components.description: Flat 12px white frame around the illustrated map, labels, markers and visible caption.
components.html:
Explore Cavite waters

Illustration only · not for navigation
components.css: .ds-map-panel { border: 1px solid var(--line, #dbe6e6); border-radius: var(--card-radius, 12px); background: var(--white, #fff); padding: var(--card-padding, 16px); color: var(--ink, #102b35); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-map-panel h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-map-panel .ds-map-caption { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #667c84); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.64; }

components.name: Numbered location option
components.description: 60px native radio row with a 24px number badge and shared selected-area state.
components.css: .ds-location-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 60px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dbe6e6); border-radius: var(--control-radius, 8px); background: var(--white, #fff); cursor: pointer; } .ds-location-row:hover { border-color: var(--teal, #087f78); } .ds-location-row:has(input:checked) { border-color: var(--teal, #087f78); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--teal-soft, #e1f3f0) 42%, var(--white, #fff)); } .ds-location-number { display: grid; width: 24px; height: 24px; flex-shrink: 0; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--map-marker-slate, #505d6e); color: #fff; font: 700 12px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-location-row:has(input:checked) .ds-location-number { background: var(--teal-action, #087f78); } .ds-location-copy { min-width: 0; flex: 1; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-location-name { display: block; color: var(--ink, #102b35); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-location-subtitle { display: block; margin-top: 2px; color: var(--muted, #667c84); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-location-row input { appearance: none; width: 14px; height: 14px; flex-shrink: 0; margin: 0; border: 2px solid var(--muted, #667c84); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--white, #fff); } .ds-location-row input:checked { border-color: var(--teal, #087f78); background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--teal, #087f78) 0 3px, transparent 3.5px); } .ds-location-row:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #56b9b0); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-location-row input:focus-visible { outline: none; } @media (forced-colors: active) { .ds-location-row input { appearance: auto; } .ds-location-row:has(input:checked) { outline: 1px solid Highlight; } }

components.name: Mobile location sheet
components.description: Native bottom-sheet dialog below 768px with 14px upper corners, safe-area padding and focus return.
components.html:
Where would you like to explore?

Choose a Cavite fishing ground. Species and legal recommendations are withheld until local records are verified.
components.css: .ds-location-sheet { position: fixed; inset: auto 0 0; width: min(100%, 560px); max-height: calc(100dvh - 24px); margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px 16px max(20px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); border: 0; border-radius: 14px 14px 0 0; background: var(--white, #fff); color: var(--ink, #102b35); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-location-sheet::backdrop { background: var(--scrim, rgb(16 43 53 / 55%)); } .ds-location-sheet h2 { flex: 1; margin: 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-location-sheet .ds-location-row { min-height: 60px; gap: 8px; padding: 10px; } .ds-sheet-done { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; margin-top: 16px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--control-radius, 8px); background: var(--teal-action, #087f78); color: #fff; font: 700 13px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-sheet-done:hover { background: var(--teal-action-hover, #05615d); } .ds-sheet-done:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #56b9b0); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The interface should feel like a clear, well-kept field guide: steady, local, and easy to scan. A pale bay-mist canvas, dark ink typography, and deep teal accents make the page feel calm without losing the confidence needed for clear actions and selected states.

Keep the map illustration and area selector visually legible and purposeful. Use compact, letter-spaced overlines to orient the reader, then let moderately weighted headings and quiet supporting copy establish hierarchy. Bilog appears as a small, warm illustration in the current prototype; keep that artwork supportive rather than making it the interface's main visual language.
keyCharacteristics: Field-guide clarity with a calm, coastal palette.
Compact controls and reusable surfaces leave the map room to lead.
Friendly rounded controls and cards, kept visually restrained.

rules.name: Review-Color
rules.body: Keep amber for review or warning information and rose for errors; neither becomes a general brand accent.

rules.name: Border-First
rules.body: Use the border and surface contrast to define a resting card; reserve shadows for floating navigation, popovers and map controls.

dos: Do keep the map, place choices, and their selected state easy to distinguish at a glance.
Do use deep teal for actions and selection, and keep headings anchored in ink.
Do pair warning and error colors with direct labels or supporting text.
Do preserve the light border, flat resting cards, sparse floating shadows, and rounded controls.
Do keep the 3px keyboard-focus treatment visible and honor reduced motion.
donts: Don't add faux-nautical decoration such as ropes, anchors, weathered paper, or generic fishing clip art.
Don't use amber as a general accent or let status color replace a readable label.
Don't spread shadows across every surface; reserve them for floating navigation, popovers and map controls.
Don't use the map's illustrated gradients and organic land shapes as a general page background treatment.
